shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books every day.
My favorite hobby is painting landscapes.
Traveling teaches us about different cultures.
Cooking new dishes can be a fun experience.
Listening to music helps me relax after work.
Gardening is a great way to spend time outdoors.
Volunteering in my community brings me joy.
Learning a new language opens many opportunities.
Exercising regularly improves both physical and mental health.
Exploring local events helps me connect with my neighbors.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about healthy eating habits.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your daily eating habits?
Q2: What challenges do you face when trying to eat healthy?
Q3: How important do you think healthy eating is for overall well-being?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone wanting to improve their diet?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about outdoor activities.
questions: Q1: What outdoor activities do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you ever faced any difficulties when participating in outdoor activities?
Q3: In your opinion, why are outdoor activities important for people?
Q4: What suggestions would you make for someone new to outdoor activities?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about workplace relationships.
questions: Q1: How would you describe your relationships with your coworkers?
Q2: What challenges have you encountered in building workplace relationships?
Q3: How do you think good relationships at work impact productivity?
Q4: What tips can you offer for improving relationships with colleagues?
